snippet.title: Edge of Memories | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Pre-order Edge of Memories now: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/edge-of-memories/9p43b4srjk0s

Created in collaboration between veteran Japanese developers and a small French studio, Edge of Memories is an upcoming action-RPG. 

For Tokyo Game Show, we're also sharing a first reveal of the Japanese dub, with voice actors and actresses who've worked on Nier Replicant, JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, Frieren & more.

Edge of Memories will release on XBOX Series X|S on November 5th!
